title: Speaking: Interview Personal Topics
focus: Responder diretamente sobre estudos e hábitos
verifiableTask: Dar seis respostas desenvolvidas de 20–40 segundos

content.text: : um entrevistador faz perguntas sobre você (estudos, hábitos, preferências) e você responde de forma
Ao final da aula você consegue:
responder perguntas pessoais em 20–40 segundos com a fórmula
dar seis respostas desenvolvidas de 20–40 segundos.
Where are you from? · What do you do? · Do you like mornings? · What's your favorite place to study?
— o aluno acrescenta 2 frases a cada resposta.
Please make sure that you submit your report no later than Friday.
What I like about it is…
To be honest, I'm a night owl, so I'm more productive in the evening.

questions.questionText: A “night owl” is a person who…

options.text: works at night as a guard

explanations.general: Correct answer: prefers to stay up late

questions.questionText: I often ______ and leave everything for the last minute. (procrastinar)

explanations.general: I often procrastinate and leave everything for the last minute.

questions.questionText: My ______ to work takes an hour by bus. (trajeto)

explanations.general: My commute to work takes an hour by bus.

questions.questionText: “I watch series to unwind.” Unwind means…
Best direct start for “Do you like studying in the morning?”

options.text: Not really. I'm more productive at night.
Well, morning is a part of the day when…

explanations.general: Correct answer: Not really. I'm more productive at night.

questions.questionText: It's hard to keep ______ with all the readings. (acompanhar)

explanations.general: It's hard to keep up with all the readings.

content.text: How do you usually prepare for an important test?
I usually start studying about two weeks before.
I make a simple plan with the topics for each day, because if I leave everything to the end, I get too stressed.
For example, for my statistics exam last semester, I reviewed one chapter a day and did practice problems on the weekend.
So that's what works for me.
≈ 30 segundos. O aluno lê junto com o professor (sombra) e depois responde à mesma pergunta com a sua versão.
O professor faz a pergunta; o aluno responde só a 1ª frase usando a estrutura indicada:
Do you prefer studying at home or in a library? →
I'd say at home, mainly because…
Do you use social media a lot? →
Transforme cada resposta curta em D-D-E falando:
“I like reading.” 2. “I study at night.” 3. “I don't like group work.” 4. “I use my phone to study.”
Ouça o professor ler a resposta abaixo e diga o que está errado:

“Well… so… this is a very interesting question. Studying is very important for everyone in the world. There are many ways to study. Some people study at home, some people study at the library. It depends on the person.” (Pergunta:

questions.questionText: What is wrong with the answer in 4.3?

options.text: It never answers the question directly and has no personal example.

explanations.general: Correct answer: It never answers the question directly and has no personal example.

questions.questionText: What comes first in the D-D-E formula?

options.text: A general statement about the world

questions.questionText: I'd say at home, mainly ______ it's quieter. (porque)

explanations.general: I'd say at home, mainly because it's quieter.

questions.questionText: How long should an interview answer be in this task?
For ______, last week I studied in the park. (exemplo)

explanations.general: For example, last week I studied in the park.

questions.questionText: Starting with “This is a very interesting question” is a good strategy.

content.text: para começar e fala 20–40 s. O professor cronometra e anota D-D-E.
Tell me about your current studies or job.
How do you usually spend your free time on weekends?
Do you prefer to study alone or with other people? Why?
What is one habit you would like to change?
How do you usually get to school or work?
What kind of music or podcasts do you listen to while studying, if any?
o aluno escolhe as 2 respostas mais fracas e responde de novo, melhorando o exemplo.
[ ] Começou com resposta direta em todas?
[ ] Deu exemplos pessoais concretos (lugar, dia, situação)?
Escreva 6 situações reais suas que servem de exemplo (uma prova, uma viagem, um projeto, um problema…).
Grave respostas D-D-E (20–40 s). Escute e anote o tempo.
night owl, procrastinate, commute, unwind, keep up with
